# Intégration des appareils et de la plateforme {#device-and-platform-integration}

Les API que Shopify range dans intégration des appareils et de la plateforme, et les types qu'elles seules utilisent. Sur cette page : [`PosApi`](#posapi), [`ScannerApi`](#scannerapi), [`WebVitalsApi`](#webvitalsapi).

## `PosApi` {#posapi}

| Membre | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cart` | <code v-pre><a href="#poscart">PosCart</a></code> | Provides methods to read and modify the current POS cart, including line items, discounts, customers, and properties. |
| `close` | <code v-pre><a href="#posclose">PosClose</a></code> | Closes the app and returns to the POS screen. |
| `device` | <code v-pre><a href="#posdevice">PosDevice</a></code> | Returns information about the POS device, including its name and serial number. |
| `location` | <code v-pre><a href="#poslocation">PosLocation</a></code> | Returns information about the current POS location, including its ID, name, address, and status. |

Utilisé dans : [useAppBridge()](/fr/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/fr/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)

### `_PosCart` {#_poscart}

| Membre | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fetch?()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#cart">Cart</a>&gt;</code> | Fetch the current cart. |
| `subscribe?()` | <code v-pre>(onSubscribe: <a href="#cartsubscriber">CartSubscriber</a>) =&gt; <a href="#unsubscribe">Unsubscribe</a></code> | Subscribe the cart changes. |
| `setCustomer?()` | <code v-pre>(customer: <a href="#customer">Customer</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Add a new or existing customer to the cart. |
| `removeCustomer?()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Remove the current customer from the cart. |
| `addAddress?()` | <code v-pre>(address: <a href="#address">Address</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Add a new address to a customer. |
| `updateAddress?()` | <code v-pre>(index: number, address: <a href="#address">Address</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Update an address for a customer. |
| `applyCartDiscount?()` | <code v-pre>(type: <a href="#discounttype">DiscountType</a>, discountDescription: string, amount: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Apply a percentage or fixed amount discount to the whole cart. |
| `applyCartCodeDiscount?()` | <code v-pre>(code: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Apply a code discount to the whole cart. |
| `removeCartDiscount?()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Remove the discount applied to the whole cart. |
| `removeAllDiscounts?()` | <code v-pre>(disableAutomaticDiscounts: boolean) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Clears all applied discounts from the cart and optionally disables automatic discounts. |
| `addCartProperties?()` | <code v-pre>(properties: Record&lt;string, string&gt;) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Add properties for the cart. |
| `removeCartProperties?()` | <code v-pre>(keys: string[]) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Remove properties from the cart. |
| `addCustomSale?()` | <code v-pre>(customSale: <a href="#customsale">CustomSale</a>) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Add custom sale for the cart. |
| `clear?()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Clear all contents from the cart. |
| `addLineItem?()` | <code v-pre>(variantId: number, quantity: number) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Add a product to the cart. |
| `updateLineItem?()` | <code v-pre>(uuid: string, quantity: number) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Make changes to a line item in the cart. |
| `removeLineItem?()` | <code v-pre>(uuid: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Remove a line item in the cart. |
| `setLineItemDiscount?()` | <code v-pre>(uuid: string, type: <a href="#discounttype">DiscountType</a>, discountDescription: string, amount: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Apply a discount to a line item. |
| `removeLineItemDiscount?()` | <code v-pre>(uuid: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Remove a discount from a line item. |
| `addLineItemProperties?()` | <code v-pre>(uuid: string, properties: Record&lt;string, string&gt;) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Add properties to a line item. |
| `removeLineItemProperties?()` | <code v-pre>(uuid: string, properties: string[]) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Remove properties from a line item. |

### `Cart` {#cart}

| Membre | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `subTotal` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The total cost of the current cart including discounts, but before taxes and shipping. Value is based on the shop's existing currency settings. |
| `taxTotal` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The sum of taxes for the current cart. Value is based on the shop's existing currency settings. |
| `grandTotal` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The total cost of the current cart, after taxes and discounts have been applied. Value is based on the shop's existing currency settings. |
| `cartDiscount?` | <code v-pre><a href="#discount">Discount</a></code> | The current discount applied to the entire cart. |
| `cartDiscounts?` | <code v-pre><a href="#discount">Discount</a>[]</code> | All current discounts applied to the entire cart and line items. |
| `customer?` | <code v-pre><a href="#customer">Customer</a></code> | The customer associated to the current cart. |
| `lineItems` | <code v-pre><a href="#lineitem">LineItem</a>[]</code> | A list of lineItem objects. |
| `properties` | <code v-pre>Record&lt;string, string&gt;</code> | A list of objects containing cart properties. |
